scope: Study-specific serving prompts derived from LongBench; not an official LongBench benchmark evaluation or score.

source.inspected_local_zip: 2026-10-16: exact byte count/hash and both task schemas verified read-only

selection: First eligible records in original JSONL order, using full rendered prompt token length; no truncation, duplication, shuffle, reference-based filtering, or outcome-based filtering. Insufficient eligible records is an error.

rendering.format: one user message using the explicitly supplied local tokenizer's chat template

lcc.prompt_template:
Continue the following code by writing only the next line. Do not repeat the existing code.

{context}
lcc.reference_semantics: Original LongBench answers list; the reference is the next line, not an arbitrary fixed-length continuation.

multi_news.prompt_template:
Write a concise summary of the following news articles.

Articles:
{context}

Summary:
multi_news.reference_semantics: Original LongBench answers list containing the reference summary.

interpretation.generation: Preparation does not generate outputs. Fixed-length generation and natural termination require separate labels in the runner.
interpretation.proposal_opportunity: Code and summarization provide additional workloads in which prompt reuse may occur; no n-gram proposal availability or performance benefit is assumed.
interpretation.length: LongBench's length field is its source word/character statistic, not the local tokenizer count; eligibility uses prompt_token_ids only.
interpretation.known_population_limit: C's existing OLMoE population has 91/200 multi_news prompts at most 2048 tokens with this content template. This advisory count does not substitute for the specified tokenizer's new scan; default 160 must fail if insufficient.
